meta.purpose: Goal decomposition engine — breaks any far-away goal into binary, actionable near-term steps, traced through the dependency graph

decomposition.description: Any goal can be decomposed by asking: what does this REQUIRE, and what does each requirement REQUIRE, until you reach something you can do TODAY.
algorithm: 2. List all requirements (from graph edges: depends_on, costs, enables)
3. For each requirement, check: is it currently satisfied?
4. If NO: what does IT require? (recurse)
6. Continue until you reach a leaf node that is either (a) currently satisfiable or (b) requires only money/skill you can earn

example_decomposition.goal: Live on estate with cows, sheep, chickens, dog, mushroom lab

chain.action: Today: identify what remote work you can do. List skills. Check job boards.
Today: reach out to BHU professors/contacts about nominee director role
When company registration starts — Part of SPICe+ filing, not separate

todayActions: Research remote income opportunities matching your skills
Reach out to 1 person at BHU about nominee director
Continue Hindi practice (earns points toward visa readiness)
Save money (earns points toward company registration)
